Bersejarah (Pindaan) 2023.

Pindaan Jadual

dipinda dalam Jadual dengan menggantikan butiran "Runtuhan Gereja St. John"

dan butir-butir yang berhubungan dengannya dengan butiran dan butir-butir

yang berikut:

Nama

(2)

(3)

No. Lot

(4)

Luas

 DATO SRI TIONG KING SING

Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

ANCIENT MONUMENTS AND HISTORICAL SITES

(AMENDMENT) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the

National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Ancient Monuments and Historical Sites

(Amendment) Order 2023.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The Ancient Monuments and Historical Sites Order 1977 [P.U. (A) 116/1977]

is amended in the Schedule by substituting for item "Runtuhan Gereja St. John"

and the particulars relating to it the following item and particulars:

SCHEDULE

(1)

Name

(2)

District

(3)

Lot No.

(4)

Area

"Kota St. John . . . . Melaka Tengah . . 100 177.3026 square metres".

 Made 13 September 2023

 [JWN. PUU.600-1/3/1; PN(PU2)652/Jld. 18]

 DATO SRI TIONG KING SING

 Ministry of Tourism, Arts and Culture
